items.name: theme-base
items.title: JHAI Theme Base
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The structural tokens this component set needs: a type scale, spacing rhythm, control heights, durations and measure caps, all prefixed --ui- so they cannot collide with your own. Colour is NOT here — components paint in shadcn semantics only, so your palette is already the palette. Install this first; every other @jhai item assumes it.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The one mono label recipe: 9.5px, 0.24em tracking, uppercase, optional NN prefix. Dark grounds render in the accent. Never restyle this recipe per section.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section Header
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Eyebrow, heading and optional right-aligned side note. Three heading scales: section, feature, display. Heading weight is always 500 and the eyebrow gap is fixed.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The v2 CTA. Primary is a solid ground-inverted fill, ghost is a hairline. Sentence case, never a gradient, never a coloured fill. Renders an anchor when href is set. Self-contained: does not fork or overwrite the shadcn button.
items.docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original: there, Button is an adapter over a forked src/components/ui/button.tsx. Shipping that fork would overwrite a consuming project's own button, so the four compound variants are inlined here instead. Rendered classes are identical.

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check List
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The inclusion / pain list. Check is a accent tick for answers and inclusions; cross is a grey cross for pains. Never a red cross, never a coloured fill. Marks are lucide icons, not text glyphs.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat Tile
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: One big tabular number with a mono caption and a left hairline. Skip the divider on the first tile of a row. Pair with @magicui/number-ticker for a count-up numeral.

items.name: image-slot
items.title: Image Slot
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The grey plate convention. Renders the image when src is set, otherwise a deliberate plate with its placeholder caption, so an empty slot reads as a hole in the layout rather than a broken image. Grayscale is the house treatment.
items.docs: The plate grey resolved through --ui-surface-strong for the registry build; it was a #ECECEA literal in the source repo. Same colour on JHAI, client colour elsewhere.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The JHAI lucide icon set and its name mapping. One place that decides which lucide glyph a named concept resolves to, so an icon does not drift between sections.

items.name: rating-mark
items.title: Rating Mark
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The one star recipe. Draws a 0-5 rating as characters so it inherits colour and size from its caption, and announces itself to a screen reader as a number rather than as five shapes. Halves round to the nearest half star.
items.docs: Never default `value`. A star mark is a factual claim about a real review; a component that defaults to 5 invents evidence every time a caller omits it. Omit the rating and draw nothing.

items.name: score-bar
items.title: Score Bar
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: One measured value on a fixed scale, with an optional reference rule and a first-class unmeasured state. A null value draws a hueless hatch and never a zero, because a bar component that treats missing as zero tells someone they failed a test that was never run.

items.name: severity-mark
items.title: Severity Mark
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: How bad a thing is, carried by colour, shape and word together so any one of the three can be lost. Octagon, triangle and circle rank without hue, which matters because a hot-to-cool ramp is the exact axis a red-green deficiency removes.

items.name: ratio-bar
items.title: Ratio Bar
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: A count against its own denominator, drawn at the proportion it actually is. Refuses to render when the count exceeds its total, because a bar drawn against the wrong denominator draws 2% where the truth is 15% and the picture is what gets believed.

items.name: content-types
items.title: Content Types
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The prop shapes the JHAI section components take. Types only, no data. In jhai-new-website these live in src/lib/v2/home.ts beside the site's content; here the types travel with the components and the data stays in whatever project renders them.

items.name: shell
items.title: Section Shell
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Container, Section, Grain and the one stylesheet the page's marquees and responsive collapses read from. Every section item depends on this: it owns the 1280 container, the three grounds, the marquee keyframes and the reduced-motion stop that Tailwind cannot express.
items.docs: Grain reads its texture from --ui-grain, which this file does not define because the SVG is a project asset. Set it beside your palette: :root { --ui-grain: url('/assets/grain.svg'); }. Unset, Grain renders nothing.

items.name: ticker
items.title: Ticker
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The outlined capability marquee. Type as texture: stroked, not filled, so it reads as a rule between sections rather than another headline.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo Wall
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The client logo strip. Pair with svgl.app for the marks themselves — see docs/CURATION.md, logo wall.

items.name: faq-item
items.title: FAQ Item
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: One disclosure row with a plus that rotates. The unit the Questions section composes.

items.name: questions
items.title: Questions
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The FAQ section: eyebrow, heading, lede and a column of disclosure rows.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The us-versus-them table. One highlighted column, check and cross marks, hairline rows.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The comparison section wrapping the table with its eyebrow and side note.

items.name: problem
items.title: Problem
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The display-scale problem statement: a three-part heading with an italic middle, a lede and a bullet list.

items.name: answer
items.title: Answer
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The feature-scale answer to the problem: split heading, lede with an italic clause, image and pillars.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA Band
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The dark close. Statement left, capture slot right. The slot is a render prop, not an import, because a capture form belongs to the project's funnel.
items.docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original, where the right slot renders GraderField, JHAI's audit-email capture. That form is a funnel, not reusable UI, so it stays project code. Pass your own component as `field`, pass `link` for a click ask instead, or pass neither for the statement-only shape.

items.name: cta-band-section
items.title: CTA Band Section
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The mid-page CTA band, wrapped in its section and container so it reads as a stop rather than a section.

items.name: record-band
items.title: Record Band
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: A row of stat tiles on either ground. Pair the numerals with @magicui/number-ticker for a count-up.

items.name: case-card
items.title: Case Card
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The case-study card: grayscale plate, badge, title and result line.

items.name: blog-card
items.title: Blog Card
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The writing card: grayscale plate, kicker, title and date.

items.name: tool-card
items.title: Tool Card
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The tool card: title, body and an arrow that slides on hover.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The page header: brand, nav, one optional ask. Mobile disclosure is a native <details>, so it works with no runtime. Variants: simple, centered.
items.docs: Not @jhai/section-header, which is a heading block inside a band. This is the page's own header. The mobile menu is a <details> because the registry ships no runtime and a server component cannot hydrate one; the native element brings keyboard handling and the open/closed announcement with it.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The social proof band. One to six quotes, each with an optional real rating drawn by RatingMark. Variants: grid, single.
items.docs: `rating` is optional and is never defaulted. A default of 5 would invent a five-star review every time a caller omitted the field. Omit it and no mark is drawn.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Brand, standfirst, two to four link columns, legal line. Variants: columns, minimal.
items.docs: Deliberately not a Section: a footer sits outside the band rhythm and takes its own padding. `minimal` is a real variant rather than `columns: []`, so an empty grid is never the way to ask for the short shape.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Eyebrow, headline, subhead, actions and optional media. Media accepts a placeholder state and renders a correctly proportioned empty plate rather than requiring a live src. Variants: centered, split.
items.docs: `media.src` is optional on purpose. A section that hard-requires a URL cannot be placed in a wireframe, and the consumer then forks the layout locally to show an empty plate. The first entry in `actions` renders primary and the rest ghost; that is a rendering rule, not content.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Plan cards carrying price, billing note and per-plan CTA, optionally over a feature comparison. Variants: cards, cards-with-comparison.
items.docs: `price` is a string and is never computed: "$95/mo", "From $1,200", "Free" and "Let's talk" are all legitimate. The highlighted card opens a nested .dark scope rather than painting a literal, which is the fix for the bug that made ComparisonTable's highlighted column invisible.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Recharts container that declares --series-1..6 from the project's own chart tokens, so charts follow a client palette instead of baking colours in. Composes Recharts chart types rather than hiding them.

items.name: carousel-rail
items.title: Carousel rail
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Embla drag rail with controls and progress dots painted from semantic tokens. Embla renders nothing itself, which is why the rail can be retokened without touching the library.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: The single entrance animation. Reads --ui-dur-med and --ui-ease from the theme so motion is a brand property, and collapses to a near-instant fade under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: Per-field validation before the round trip, with one zod schema usable unchanged inside a server action. Submission is the caller's, because where a lead goes is a per-client decision.

items.name: booking-embed
items.title: Booking Embed
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.description: A GoHighLevel booking calendar that actually appears. The vendor script parks the iframe off-screen while the widget boots and does not always reveal it, and resolves its width against the window rather than the column. Both are reversed here, with a printable address fallback.
